patch_feedback.error: Regression tests must pass each literal issue input unchanged to the function under test: range(1,8). Wrapping it in another constructor changes the input contract. Add a NEW test filename; existing tests are immutable.

contract_tests: paginate(list(range(1, 8)), 2, 2) == [3, 4] and result is a list (literal issue example, one-based page 2).
paginate(list(range(1, 8)), 1, 2) == [1, 2] (page 1 is the first page, one-based).
paginate(list(range(1, 8)), 5, 2) == [] and paginate(list(range(1, 8)), 100, 2) == [] (beyond last page returns []).
paginate([1, 2, 3], 1, 10) == [1, 2, 3] and paginate([1, 2, 3], 2, 10) == [] (page_size larger than items).
paginate([1, 2, 3, 4], 2, 2) == [3, 4], result is not the input list, and input remains [1, 2, 3, 4] (no mutation).
patches.rationale: The bug: `start = page * page_size` treats page as zero-based, so page 1 returns items[page_size:2*page_size]. For one-based pagination, start must be `(page - 1) * page_size`. This preserves the invalid-input guard (page < 1 or page_size < 1 -> []) and naturally returns [] beyond the last page via slicing. The literal example range(1,8), page 2, size 2 must yield [3,4]. A new regression test file tests/test_pagination_regression.py is added; existing tests are untouched.
